newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot propane steady to weaker, data awaited.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot propane steady to weaker, data awaited.

text.p: U.S. spot propane prices were steady to weaker in light trade on Friday as many traders awaited industry inventory data due out later today.
"There were spurts but it has mostly been quiet," said one Houston broker.
In Mont Belvieu, Texas, the asking price for spot propane drifted down 0.25 cent to 48.50 cents a gallon, with buyers still at 48.25 cents.
Conway, Kansas, hub held at 47.50/47.75 cents with little demand. Farm cooperatives, which had been in the market much of the week, did not appear Friday, players said.
"I think everyone is waiting for APIs, that's holding everything up," said one Midwest trader.
Trade was quiet in the heavies and most prices were stable.
-- Laney Salisbury New York Energy Desk +1 212 859 1631
